name: long_chain
description: A six-stage pipeline with one exception-raising one-line bug per stage; every test of stage N feeds the shared RAW text through stages 1..N, so at the start all sixteen pipeline tests fail with the same ValueError in load.parse_row and form one goal. Fixing stage k lets stage k's tests pass and moves the remaining failures to stage k+1's frame: load.parse_row passes the kind where the price belongs, float(kind) for float(price) (ValueError on the first row), clean_row reads row.label for row.name (AttributeError), to_record indexes LABELS by row.name for row.kind (KeyError), ranked sorts by kv[2] for kv[1] (IndexError), layout.rows calls lines.add for lines.append (AttributeError) and report joins with the undefined SEPARATOR for SEP (NameError). Progress can only come one stage at a time: 16 -> 13 -> 10 -> 6 -> 4 -> 2 -> 0 failing (by_label and grand_total do not go through ranked, so they pass with stage 3). Sixteen tests fail, ten pass (empty-input and helper tests).
